title: feat(lint): advise a dataset measure or dimension that declares neither synonyms nor a description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

Closes #34718

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @objectstack/lint gains three exports on its "." entry: validateDatasetMemberVocabulary, DATASET_MEMBER_NO_VOCABULARY and the DatasetMemberVocabularyFinding type; nothing accepted before is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim amendment applied (seat comment 6947260430 on the card), round-1 head `b5554ad9cb`: Gap 1 = A (the `os generate dataset` scaffold seeds member synonyms from labels; the zero-finding scaffold test is unchanged), Gap 2 = A (examples keep `synonyms` only; descriptions and bundle translations belong to a separate card), Gap 3 (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts` is in the surface). Second amendment (seat comment 6949469635, after L1 ACCEPT 6949452870 with should-fix S1), head `80edbdae04`: S1 is closed in this PR, `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` joined the surface and their example members now carry vocabulary; N1 names `generate-permission-dataset.pin.test.ts` in the surface. Third amendment (seat comment 6951572798, answering the seat's L2 record 6951558966, PASS with should-fix S1), head `4b69badef9`: the L2 S1 is closed on this head, the `Clause-②` line here and in the changeset is restated as a widening (three new `@objectstack/lint` exports; `Metadata-protocol: none` and all three `patch` levels unchanged); `projectTasksDataset` in `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` gets synonyms on its six members; the Gap 2 descriptions and bundle translations are carried by #34873.

Final head `5566847410`: a clean `--no-ff` merge of `origin/main` (`fc5913e117`, 29 first-parent commits) on top of `4b69badef9`, ordered by the seat. `git show --remerge-diff` of the merge is empty (no hand resolution); the delta against `origin/main` is the same 23 files, +815/-82, as before the merge. On the merged head: main prints 69 author-time rules and this branch 70 in the four transcript pages; `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 0 after building the CLI closure (exit 3, prerequisite, before it); `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring` exit 0; the rule's three lint test files (`validate-dataset-member-vocabulary`, `rule-id-barrel-exports`, `runtime-gate.dataset-writes`) 37 tests passed. `overlap-check` at this head: exit 1 against draft PR 34791 only, unchanged. Readings below that name an earlier head were taken at that head and not repeated here; the rest is CI's on this head.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集的指标或维度如果既没写 `synonyms` 也没写 `description`，校验（`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`）和发布保存时会给一条提醒，每个成员一条，只提醒不拒绝；dashboards 技能改为教「按用户提问的语言写同义词，加一句业务定义，一个词只指一个成员」，并加了一条中文需求的评测用例；todo 和 showcase 两个示例的数据集成员补了同义词；`os generate dataset` 生成的脚手架现在给每个成员写一条从已有标签取的同义词，并注释提醒作者换成用户真正会说的词。
- 为什么改：同义词是用户用自己的话问数时命中受管指标的唯一途径（ADR-0149 D1），此前没有任何检查提示作者去写，应用可以发布一批没有同义词的数据集而全部通过。
- 风险与回滚：只新增提醒，不改任何已有判定；回滚即 revert 本 PR。脚手架写出的同义词只是标签原文（中文标签就是中文词），不是用户口语，靠注释提醒作者替换。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.ts`（规则本身）；`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`（对外技能的教学改写，替换了原有四行注释）；`packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts`（脚手架同义词取词与撞词回退）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.test.ts`，预期 12 条全过。
- 需要你做的：请 os-zhuang 审批。这是 Tier H：改到 `skills/**`，同时发布 lint 与 cli，`Clause-②` 为 yes，不符合技能低风险放权条件。依据见席位记录 6953337113；本 head 已有 L1-a delta ACCEPT 6953282003 和席位 L2 delta PASS 6953278488，批准后由 o3-B 落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/lint`**: one advisory authoring rule, `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` (`warning`, never `error`), in `validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.ts`. It reports once per dataset measure or dimension that has no non-blank `synonyms` entry and no non-blank `description` (a string, or an inline locale map with one non-blank value). The finding's location names the dataset and the member; the sentence says the member answers only to its own name and label, so a question in a user's own words does not find it. One of the two keys silences it.
- Registered in `authoring-rules.ts` as `advisory`, on all three commands, on the runtime publish door for a `dataset` write (`runtimeTypes: ['dataset']`). `rule-explanations.ts` gains the `os explain dataset-member-no-vocabulary` entry; `index.ts` exports the function, the id constant and the finding type.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`**: the four-line member comment under the dataset example is rewritten to say: every member gets `synonyms`, the words a person types, in the brief's language (matched, never translated; one word names one member), and a one-sentence business `description`, never a prompt; a member with neither draws the new warning. The example's `signed_date` dimension gains a synonym so the example does not draw the warning it teaches.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json`**: eval 9, a dataset authored from a Chinese brief, expecting Chinese `synonyms` and a Chinese one-sentence `description` on every member, and refusing a locale-keyed synonyms map. The evals README names it.
- **Examples (data only)**: every member of `todo_task_metrics` (9) and of the four showcase datasets (30) gains `synonyms`. Convention followed: the one `examples/app-crm` uses, English and Chinese words in the one list.
- **`packages/cli` (`os generate dataset`)**: the scaffold writes one `synonyms` entry on each of its two members, seeded from a label the stack already declares, under a comment telling the author to replace the seed with the words users type and to add a `description`. The dimension takes the title field's label, else the title-cased field name; the record count takes the object's plural label, else its label. A seed that would also name the other member (by `normalizeDatasetTerm`) is skipped for the next candidate, so the scaffold always parses. The bound-object binding gains `displayFieldLabel`.
- **Docs transcripts**: the author-time rule count the CLI prints goes 69 to 70 in the four pages that quote it.
- **Dataset guides (S1)**: in `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` the example's 3 dimensions and 5 measures each gain `synonyms`, and 4 measures gain a one-sentence `description`; a new Key rules bullet names the two keys, what a member with neither costs a user (a question in their own words misses the governed metric) and the advisory id `dataset-member-no-vocabulary`. In `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` the 4 members of `salesDataset` gain `synonyms` and `revenue` gains a `description`. Both examples stay in English, the language they were written in. Round 3: the page's second dataset, `projectTasksDataset` (3 dimensions, 3 measures), gains English `synonyms` on every member.
- **Two existing fixtures** that pin the dataset publish door are updated because this rule joins that door: `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts` (the exact rule list at the door, and the app-crm corpus copy, which predated the vocabulary the shipped dataset now carries) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts` (its "clean dataset" had bare members and asserted no advisories; its members now carry `synonyms`). The second file joined the surface by the claim amendment.
- **CLI pins**: `generate-permission-dataset.pin.test.ts` pins the seeded synonyms, a Chinese-labelled object, and four collision cases; `test/generate-binds-from-stack.test.ts` names the new `displayFieldLabel` in the binding it pins (a pin this change made stale; not named in the amendment).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/skills`, each patch.

## Why

ADR-0149 D1 makes `synonyms` and `description` the vocabulary a business question is matched and explained by, and both are optional. Nothing prompted an author to write them, so an app could publish datasets with none and pass every check, and its users then got ungoverned numbers for questions the app has a governed metric for.

## Tests

Readings are from this worktree at the head each line names; the final head is `4b69badef9`, which adds two commits on `b5554ad9cb` that touch docs and the changeset only (merge-base with `origin/main` is `3bbda33b78`; main, at `e9f65a3b57`, was 14 first-parent commits ahead at the last push and merges cleanly). At the round-3 push main was at `fc5913e117`, 29 first-parent commits past the merge-base; it was not merged in (the round's order was one commit), `git merge-tree` against it is clean, and it still prints 69.

The one failure was the bound-object pin in `test/generate-binds-from-stack.test.ts`, which did not name `displayFieldLabel`. After that pin was updated, at `b5554ad9cb`: `test/generate-binds-from-stack.test.ts`, `test/generate-scaffold-validates.test.ts` and `src/commands/generate-permission-dataset.pin.test.ts` read exit 0, 3 files, 74 tests passed. The whole unit tier was not rerun at `b5554ad9cb`; the integration tier is CI's.
- Docs examples through the rule, at `80edbdae04` (a scratch script extracted each `defineDataset` literal from the page, ran `DatasetSchema.safeParse` and `validateDatasetMemberVocabulary` from the built `@objectstack/lint`, and was deleted): `analytics.mdx` as written, 8 members, parse succeeds, 0 findings; control with the added keys stripped, 8 findings. `dashboards.mdx` as written, 4 members, parse succeeds, 0 findings; control stripped, 4 findings.
- Round 3, at `4b69badef9`, the same scratch check (deleted again), now also folding every member's name, label and synonyms with `normalizeDatasetTerm` and counting terms owned by two members: `projectTasksDataset` as written, 6 members, parse succeeds, 0 findings, 18 folded terms, 0 cross-member collisions; control stripped, 6 findings. `salesDataset`: 0 findings, 12 terms, 0 collisions; control 4. `analytics.mdx` `SalesDataset`: 0 findings, 25 terms, 0 collisions; control 8.
- Scaffold output for a non-English stack, measured by rendering the template for an object labelled `发票` whose title field `invoice_no` is labelled `发票号`: the dimension line carries `synonyms: ['发票号']` and the `record_count` line carries `synonyms: ['发票']`. The seed is the label as written, in the label's language; nothing is translated or transliterated. With no field label the seed is the title-cased field name (`Name`), with no plural label it is the object label (`Account`). These are labels, not user phrasing, which is what the scaffold's comment says.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.test.ts`, 12 tests: silent on a complete dataset; one finding per member on a dataset stripped of both keys; silent on a member with only synonyms and on a member with only a description (string and locale map); an empty list, a blank string and an empty map read as not declared; registry entry is advisory on three commands and the `dataset` door; each of `validate`, `build`, `lint` reports 4 warnings on the stripped dataset and none on the complete one; the publish door returns 4 advisories and zero errors, and reports nothing for a bare stored sibling.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/runtime-authoring-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts`: exit 0, 5 passed. Before the fixture edit, the full `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` at `0aebfd190` plus working tree read 1 failed (this file), 23055 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0 (at `c3d9575bb`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test` 51 passed; `example-todo` 249 passed; `example-showcase` 545 passed; all exit 0. Their three `typecheck` runs exit 0 (at `c3d9575bb`).
- `test/generate-scaffold-validates.test.ts` is unchanged and green: the `os g dataset` scaffold adds no finding at any severity. Before the scaffold change (head `25b81e2190`) that case read exit 1, 1 failed, 25 passed.
- Ablation (one, on the rule's guard): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the early return so every member reads as declared; mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `31d46e12ed19` to `f03adde23089`); the rule's test file went 8 failed, 4 passed; restore verified (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). A first attempt used an undefined identifier and failed by throwing, so it was discarded and rerun with a behavioural mutation.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The `os generate dataset` scaffold (ruled, Gap 1 = A).** The scaffold seeds synonyms from labels, as described above; the zero-finding scaffold test is not relaxed. A seeded synonym is a starting word, not vocabulary: for an object whose labels are English the scaffold's dataset answers to English words only until the author edits it.
2. **Example members carry `synonyms` only, no `description` (ruled, Gap 2 = A).** A member `description` is display text, so it is an expected translation key. Measured on `examples/app-todo`: adding 9 member descriptions moved `i18n/missing-dataset` from 22 to 40 and the config's untranslated total from 106 to 124, which `check:i18n-coverage` refuses as growth over its baseline of 106. Translating them means editing the examples' translation bundles, outside the claim's data-only surface; the seat ruled that work to a separate card, which is #34873. With synonyms only the count stays 106 and the rule is silent.
3. **Overlap with open draft PR 34791**: `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at `4b69badef9` answers exit 1; that PR shares the four transcript count pages and lint source files (`authoring-rules.ts`, `index.ts`). Not resolved here against an unmerged PR; whichever lands second re-derives the count. `origin/main` (`fc5913e117`), PR 34850 and PR 34717 merge cleanly, and main still prints 69.
4. No user-facing sentence catalog (`user-text.ts`) is added for this rule; its consumers render `message`, as they do for the other advisory without one on a publish door (`email-template-default-reads-as-path`).
5. **Dataset guides (L1 S1 and the L2 note, both met).** True of the tree at `4b69badef9`: `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` (one dataset) and `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` (both of its datasets, `salesDataset` and `projectTasksDataset`) teach no bare member; see What changes and Tests. Other pages that show a dataset literal were not swept.
6. The platform's own five system datasets (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`) declare neither key on their 7 members. Read from source only; `os lint` over the platform-objects extract config reported 0 findings of this rule, so no door was measured reporting them.
